acceptanceCriteria: A runner child receives only the environment it needs, rather than inheriting every variable the operator's shell happens to carry
A runner that echoes its environment, or an error that embeds one, cannot persist a live credential into a retained transcript
The credential boundary rests on what is passed in, not on a pattern list guessing what came out
Existing runners keep working: the allow-list covers what claude, codex, and cursor genuinely require, verified by the real-CLI probe across every configured profile
Pattern-based redaction remains as a second layer, never as the only one
deliverables: An environment allow-list for spawned runner children in src/runner/dispatcher.ts, replacing the current full process.env inheritance
Per-runner required-variable sets, established by probing the real CLIs rather than by assumption
A test that seeds a credential-shaped variable into the parent environment and asserts it never reaches the child or its retained transcript
title: Pass runners an allow-listed environment instead of inheriting the operator's
verification: A credential-shaped variable seeded in the parent environment is absent from both the child environment and the retained transcript
